versions.changelog:
- Added a "Start on APIDot" section in the SKILL.md to provide clear entry points for users starting from ClawHub.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to the core documentation or workflow guidance; content remains documentation-only with external integration notes.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify official model page, docs, account dashboard, and example repos as direct links for first steps.

Initial release of the APIDot MiniMax Music 2.6 API skill:

- Provides docs-based workflows for APIDot MiniMax Music 2.6 API, focusing on async AI music, lyric, and instrumental generation.
- Includes guidance for task submission, polling, webhook integration, and safe API key management.
- No executable code or automated API integration; all guidance is documentation-only.
- Clearly routes users to the appropriate APIDot docs, model pages, and integration notes.
- Emphasizes security best practices and model-specific workflows for music generation use cases.
